title: Can I BEAT Martin with 1 Copycat?
summary: Tony has only a king and one Copycat vs Martin's full army. The Copycat must move like whichever piece type Martin just moved (free choice on move one). He keeps it near (but not too near) Martin's king, waits for Martin to move the 'right' piece, and finally mates when Martin moves his queen so the copycat can move like a queen to g6 (~8:15).
rules: Player: king + 1 Copycat. Martin: full standard army.
Copycat must move as the piece type the opponent moved last turn (pawn: pawn-style one/two steps forward in the player's direction; knight; bishop; rook; queen; king). First move: player chooses.
If the copycat can't make a move of that type, the player moves the king instead (inferred).
More copycats would be added if he lost (not needed).

custom_pieces.name: Copycat
custom_pieces.moves: moves like the piece type the opponent last moved

setup: White: Ke1 + Copycat on d1 (queen square, inferred). Black: full army.
